subject: Re: Train tickets
text: Hi. Thanks. Yes. The change is fine. I checked the options. Morning slots are gone. One later bus remains. It is slower. However it is cheaper. That may suit us. You asked about tickets. I can book them. Please send the names. I will use the shared card. You will repay me. No problem. I also asked about luggage. Two bags are allowed. One can be small. One can be larger. We should keep it simple. Please check the times. The station is still correct. The entrance is south. I will wait there. You will find me. If you are delayed, call. My number is in the old thread. I will message updates. Weather may affect the route. I will watch alerts. Do not worry. We have a fallback plan. If the bus fails, I know a taxi service. It is nearby. It is reliable. Cost may vary. I can estimate it. Please reply when able. I will wait for names. Then I book seats. After booking, I send a copy. That way you can check details. This should keep us aligned. Thanks for patience. I appreciate it. Talk soon. Please note. Parking is tight. Bring a card. The bus has wifi. It may be poor. Download maps first. I will send docs. Ask if lost. I am happy. This keeps things simple. Please do not worry early. I will help. Send names soon today.
